title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Lau Associates LLC’s 2nd Largest Position
text:
Lau Associates LLC boosted its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 9.0% during the third quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the SEC. The fund owned 68,056 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 5,638 shares during the period. Apple accounts for about 8.7% of Lau Associates LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 2nd largest holding. Lau Associates LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $15,363,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
Other institutional investors and hedge funds have also added to or reduced their stakes in the company. Peoples Financial Services CORP. lifted its stake in Apple by 17.6% during the third quarter. Peoples Financial Services CORP. now owns 20,840 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,704,000 after purchasing an additional 3,120 shares in the last quarter. Parkside Financial Bank & Trust lifted its stake in Apple by 2.6% during the third quarter. Parkside Financial Bank & Trust now owns 29,163 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $6,584,000 after purchasing an additional 735 shares in the last quarter. Rathbone Brothers plc lifted its stake in Apple by 1.5% during the third quarter. Rathbone Brothers plc now owns 417,151 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $94,168,000 after purchasing an additional 6,313 shares in the last quarter. Bridge Creek Capital Management LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 56.6% during the third quarter. Bridge Creek Capital Management LLC now owns 40,729 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $7,337,000 after purchasing an additional 14,721 shares in the last quarter. Finally, BLB&B Advisors LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 9.6% during the third quarter. BLB&B Advisors LLC now owns 70,025 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $15,807,000 after purchasing an additional 6,116 shares in the last quarter. A number of research analysts have commented on the company. Daiwa Capital Markets set a $200.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday. ValuEngine cut Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research note on Friday. DA Davidson decreased their price target on Apple to $260.00 and set a “buy” rating on the stock in a research note on Thursday. New Street Research upgraded Apple from a “reduce” rating to a “neutral” rating in a research note on Thursday. Finally, JPMorgan Chase & Co. reiterated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Thursday. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-six have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have assigned a buy rating to the stock. Apple has a consensus rating of “Hold” and an average price target of $195.75.
In related news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this link . Corporate insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $148.26 on Monday. The firm has a market capitalization of $775.31 billion, a P/E ratio of 12.45, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.21 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $142.00 and a 12 month high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. The firm had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company posted $2.07 earnings per share. Analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 13.18 EPS for the current fiscal year.

Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
